title: Security baseline
content:
# Security baseline

Applied to every switch after the [[Base configuration template]].

## AAA with TACACS+

```
aaa new-model
tacacs server TACACS-1
 address ipv4 10.10.5.30
 key <SHARED-SECRET>
aaa group server tacacs+ TACACS-GROUP
 server name TACACS-1
aaa authentication login default group TACACS-GROUP local
aaa authorization exec default group TACACS-GROUP local
```

Keep one local emergency account in the password vault. It only works when TACACS+ is unreachable.

## DHCP snooping and the web server

```
ip dhcp snooping
ip dhcp snooping vlan 10,20,50
!
no ip http server
no ip http secure-server
```

Uplinks must be trusted (`ip dhcp snooping trust`), or clients stop getting addresses. See [[Access and trunk ports]].

## Checklist

- ☑ SSH version 2 only, no Telnet
- ☑ TACACS+ for all logins
- ☑ HTTP and HTTPS servers disabled
- ☑ Unused ports shut down in VLAN 999
- ☐ 802.1X on desk ports (planned for next year)
